home.tutorQuestion1: Why was my answer to yesterday's solids of revolution problem wrong?
home.tutorAnswer1: You used the disk method, but the region is rotated around the $y$-axis. In this case, the shell method is a better fit: $V = 2\pi\int_a^b x\,f(x)\,dx$.
home.tutorQuestion2: When should I use disks versus shells?
home.tutorAnswer2: Use disks when slices are perpendicular to the axis of rotation; use shells when slices are parallel to the axis.
home.tutorDescription: Zyra can answer from available course materials and cite its sources, including chapters, example questions, and related quizzes.

about.title: About Zyx
about.intro: We are building a learning space that helps ITB students understand their coursework, practice with direction, and get help when they need it.
about.storyTitle: Learn with more direction and depth.
about.storyOne: Zyx grew from the experience of facing a demanding first-year common program and the need for more structured guidance. We want students to see how concepts connect, rather than only collect notes for the next exam.
about.storyTwo: That is why Zyx brings materials, practice, explanations, and tutorial options into one flow. We focus on first- and second-year ITB students who need a clearer foundation for learning.
about.principlesTitle: Principles you can see in the product.
about.principlesIntro: These practices are visible in Zyx's learning flow. They are not promises of academic results.
about.principleAlignedDescription: Content follows the courses and chapters students are studying.
about.principlePracticeDescription: Quizzes, flashcards, and explanations help students identify concepts to review.
about.principleSupportDescription: Self-paced learning can be supplemented with tutorials based on the chosen plan.
about.founderSectionTitle: Academic direction and product development work together.
about.founderSectionDescription: Each founder has a distinct area of responsibility. Adi focuses on connecting learning needs, content structure, and the web experience students use.
about.peopleTitle: The people behind our academic and technical direction.
about.peopleDescription: Each member brings a different responsibility, from academics and content to technology systems and robotics.
about.founderAdiBio: A 2022 Mechanical Engineering student at ITB, academic assistant for science and engineering courses, and Zyx's academic lead.
about.founderAdiContribution: Leads academic direction and helps shape Zyx's web product, including its material structure, learning flow, and content authoring tools.
about.founderDawamBio: An Electrical Engineering student focused on FPGA, microcontrollers, digital system design, and embedded systems.
about.founderHeidiBio: An Electrical Engineering student focused on robotics, autonomous systems, UAVs, ROVs, ROS, and vision-based control.
about.founderRaihanBio: An Informatics Engineering student focused on blockchain development, smart contracts, and full-stack web development.

privacy.pageDescription: How Zyx Academy manages and protects your personal data.

blocks.text: This policy explains how Zyx Academy manages personal data when you use our website, account, learning materials, quizzes, tutorials, Zyra, notifications, and other features we provide.
By using the service, you understand that data will be processed under this policy and applicable law.
We may collect the following categories of data:

items: Account data, such as your name, email address, profile photo, role, and authentication and session information.
Academic data, such as enrolled classes, material progress, quiz answers, assessment results, flashcard history, schedules, and learning activity.
Content and communications, such as questions to Zyra, tutorial messages, feedback, and files you upload through available features.
Technical data, such as device and browser information, IP address, access records, notification tokens, and diagnostic and usage analytics data.
Local device data, such as display preferences, study notes, bookmarks, and feature status saved in your browser storage.

blocks.text: We use data fairly and only as needed to:

items: provide, secure, and maintain the service;
manage accounts, class access, schedules, and service communications;
show relevant progress, learning recommendations, feedback, and learning features;
process requests involving tutors, artificial intelligence, or other service integrations;
prevent misuse, address disruptions, and improve service quality and reliability;
meet legal obligations.

blocks.text: Processing may be based on consent, providing a service you requested, balanced legitimate interests, or legal obligations, depending on the context.

Some features use service providers for authentication, hosting, storage, databases, analytics, notifications, academic integrations, and artificial intelligence processing. Data is shared only as needed to provide those functions or meet legal obligations.

Input you send to artificial intelligence features may be processed with relevant learning context to produce a response. Do not send sensitive personal data or confidential information that is not needed for learning.
Service providers may process data in different locations. If cross-border processing occurs, we will take the steps required by applicable law.

We use cookies and similar technologies to maintain sign-in sessions, save preferences, enable features, remember choices, and understand how the service is used. Some data is stored only on your device through browser storage.
You can manage cookies through your browser. Blocking cookies or clearing local storage may end your session or prevent some features from working as intended.
We keep data for as long as needed to provide the service, meet legal obligations, resolve disputes, and maintain security. Retention periods may vary by data type and processing purpose.
We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect data. However, no electronic system is entirely risk-free. Contact us promptly if you suspect unauthorized access to your account.

Under applicable law, you may request information about data processing, access, correction, deletion, suspension or restriction of processing, withdrawal of consent, and may raise an objection. Some rights may be limited or require identity verification.
You can manage some communication preferences in your account notification settings. You can send other requests through the contact details below.
If applicable law requires parent or guardian consent for you to use the service or provide personal data, make sure that consent is obtained before using Zyx Academy.

We may update this policy when our service, data practices, or applicable law changes. The latest update date will appear on this page. For material changes, we may provide additional notice through the service or available communication channels.
For privacy questions or requests, contact us at {email}.

support.title: When self-study is not enough, choose the right support.
support.selfStudyBody: Free opens the first chapter of every course, including articles, Diktat materials, quizzes, and flashcards. Diktat materials are read-only, and Zyra includes 5 questions per day.
support.scheduledBody: Essential adds 15 in-person tutorials for one semester.
support.intensiveBody: Premium adds on-demand assignment consultations and 30 in-person tutorials in total.

free.question: What comes with Free access?
free.answer: Free gives full access to the first chapter of each course, including articles, Diktat materials, quizzes, and flashcards. Diktat materials can be read without downloading. Zyra includes 5 questions per day.

preview.question: Can I see the features before creating an account?
preview.answer: Yes. Try the demo for one selected course with a full article, the first two Diktat sections, five flashcards, three quiz questions, and a sample Zyra conversation.

paid.question: How do the paid plans differ?
paid.answer: Minimal focuses on self-paced learning. Essential adds video explanations and 15 in-person tutorials per semester. Premium adds on-demand assignment consultations and 30 in-person tutorials in total.

pricing.question: How are the displayed prices calculated?
pricing.answer: The main price is shown per person per semester. The total depends on the selected number of people and courses.

tutorial.question: How do tutorials work?
tutorial.answer: Essential and Premium include in-person tutorials. Discuss scheduling, group needs, and activation with an administrator.

activation.question: How do I activate a plan?
activation.answer: Payment is handled outside the website through an administrator. Discuss your group setup, confirm the current price, and access will be activated for the selected plan.
